correctness.rationale: Exact expressions for each of the first five greedy denominators prove the residue cases. A nonsquare discriminant excludes the extra mod-7 branch. The bundled integer checker passed 9590 primes; finite checks are only corroboration.

originality.rationale: The claimed original content is the exact six-term prime residue characterization, the class densities (13/48,5/48), and a proved least possible congruence modulus 1260. The well-known length-two and earlier four-term cases are background and not counted as novelty. Direct mathematical-results and primary full-text searches returned no equivalent sharp-conductor classification; this remains best-knowledge originality rather than an independent novelty certificate.
residual_risks: An unindexed older complete prime-stopping table or a stronger explicit congruence theorem may exist.
An earlier general stopping-period theorem makes much of the method algorithmic, so value rests on the sharp new conductor and exact arithmetic class densities, not periodicity alone.
First-public-day archival record available for the 2011 source; earlier 2001 and 2010 journal papers are older but their precise public calendar days are not documented.

value.rationale: The least congruence conductor and complete first unsolved six-term prime stopping stratum quantify a natural invariant of the odd-greedy algorithm. Prime density 13/48 and the precise positive-density residual 5/48 offer substantive baseline facts despite the open global termination question. This is more than a renaming of periodicity or a routine isolated example.
